text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that crying over there...
Maki-chan? Whatever is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Maki-chan
text_block_list.text:
...! It's nothing.
Good luck, Bright-chan... And,
someday... let's play a lot together, just like old times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Maki-chan, I'm sorry.
Please... watch over me just a little longer, okay?
